mapper.select: SELECT role.custom_role_id, role.role_name, role.version, role.status, COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg(permission.permission_code, ',' ORDER BY permission.permission_code) FROM organization_access.tenant_custom_role_permission permission WHERE permission.custom_role_id = role.custom_role_id ), '') AS permission_codes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_access.tenant_custom_role_binding binding WHERE binding.tenant_id = role.tenant_id AND binding.custom_role_id = role.custom_role_id) AS bound_member_count FROM organization_access.tenant_custom_role role WHERE role.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY role.status ASC, role.role_name ASC, role.custom_role_id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
